correctness.rationale: The script constructs all 40 vertices and the weighted intersection matrix from the source rules. Exact integer arithmetic verifies G^3-16G^2-336G=0, tr(G)=-80, and tr(G^2)=2080. Since G is symmetric, the eigenvalues lie in {0,28,-12}; the two trace equations force multiplicities 1,9,30. Thus the characteristic polynomial, rank, and inertia follow exactly.
